name: smwmusic-castlevania-iii-dracula-s-curse-aquarius-remix
title: Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse  - Aquarius (Remix)
description:
A remix of Aquarius from Castlevania III.

I tried to follow the same spark I had after my remix of Bloody Tears. This one's pretty experimental, especially in the second loop.

Maybe it's the name of the song, but I tried to get for a very wet sound, whatever that means.
